test_case.purpose: Verify a fully populated system completes 100 graceful OS warm-reboot cycles at margin with stable readiness, complete device enumeration and no unexpected errors.
required_package: Approved warm-reboot command and no-power-removal proof
Environment tolerances and per-cycle log/device policy
test_case.test_command: Operator establishes inventory, preserved logs and calibrated margin. For each of 100 cycles issue only the approved graceful OS reboot, record old/new boot IDs and evidence that platform power stayed applied, observe shutdown/POST/OS/service readiness by deadlines, compare full inventory and collect log deltas. Stop on failure; after cycle100 restore nominal environment and verify health.
test_case.expected_result: All 100 distinct boot-ID transitions satisfy warm-reset semantics and readiness deadlines, retain every expected device, contain no disallowed error/hang/BSOD, and finish with healthy nominal restoration.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires 100 independently evidenced warm reboots. Cold/full-power/AC cycles, fewer cycles, retried failures, cleared logs or final-boot-only evidence cannot pass.
safety_gate: Maintain BMC/console access and platform power
Abort on boot loop, deadline, device loss, thermal/rail or log fault
Preserve evidence; no auto-retry; restore nominal
expected_evidence: Exact reboot command and power-state proof
test_case.recovery: On a failed reboot, stop the sequence, preserve its console/log/inventory state, use approved BMC/console recovery without reclassifying it as another cycle, restore nominal conditions and do not automatically retry.
